parsed.explanation: No criminalisation, no documented trans-specific violence pattern, and strong institutions — but the dossier documents an enforced, expanding state layer of birth-sex rules: a top-court ruling mandating biological-sex reading of single-sex services, custody placement by birth sex upheld, strip-searching by sex at birth across at least two police services, a statutory single-sex-spaces code in force (UN-criticised), and a planned hospital-ward exclusion with one documented death case (Joelle) involving state-run care denial. These are tier-1/tier-2 institutional exposures, efficiently enforced — rule-of-law here is partly liability, since litigation record shows courts and policy actively removing accommodations. Media hostility is documented as vitriolic. Offsets: no border/document friction documented, gender-reassignment discrimination protection remains, recourse mechanisms (challenges, inquest) operate. Sits at the top of Elevated Risk: exposures are real and institutional but confined to custody, search, wards and single-sex services, with no documented street violence or criminalisation of visitors.
